prompt: WHITE-LINE WOOD ENGRAVING / scratchboard illustration. The image is SOLID BLACK, and every form is revealed by FINE WHITE CARVED LINES cut out of that black — dense parallel line shading, stippling, contour cuts that follow the shape of each object, radiating cut lines where light falls. No grey washes, no gradients, no soft glow: only black, white carved line, and ONE accent of SATURATED WARM GOLD used exclusively for light sources. Bold graphic composition, high contrast, hand-cut irregularity. No text, no lettering, no signage, no runes. An enormous ancient standing stone filling the frame, its rough surface carved in dense white contour lines and stipple, moss on one shoulder as heavy white stippling. Slim modern instrument bands and a small sensor housing fitted to it, drawn in precise white cut line, one cable running down into the ground. A vertical column of simple TALLY MARKS cut into its face burns FLAT SATURATED GOLD — just plain strokes, a count, not a language. At its base, tiny, one being: a black silhouette with carved white rim-light, looking up. Solid black sky above, a low black horizon of hills in white line.
